scope: Sixteen real Workspace loopback cases with generated encrypted keys and private IPC/helper/OpenSSH/SFTP. Actual directory -> selected raw name/Version -> protected bounded path fields -> upload source inspection or download version lookup -> full software review/explicit overwrite -> 32MiB file transfer. Fixed file records, background authentication parking/fresh-view input rejection, streaming directory refresh/hide, pane switching, visible task cancel, source replacement refusal, explicit cleanup/join, byte verification and retained Status credit lifetime. Sidebar hidden after launch to isolate file-auth switching from automatic directory loads. Five lookup cases inject missing type/time into cached real entries; real LSTAT covers success, auth cancel, direct form cancel (either queued retirement without completion or running cancelled result), known-size mismatch and actual symlink refusal. No native file chooser/window/IME/clipboard, live SSH terminal pane, GUI latency, full-process memory cap, long-run or other-platform acceptance. Initial directory and lookup challenge counts asserted separately; requests in final marker counts file prompts (or lookup prompts on lookup-failure exits); max_tick_ns unavailable for early lookup exits. No user SSH files or credentials.
